status: release candidate for PR #12 review (not accepted until merged; defaultForNewDrills stays false)
name: Flare训练人物 v2plus：v2 身体 + 手指骨骼 + 设计肌群分区 + 可选皮肤/训练服/基础网格

handPose.left: optional: open | relaxed | palm-floor | grip-bar | band-grip (default: picked from the pose and props; every prop whose builder calls P.bakeGrip, i.e. gripHand, grip, dHandle, landmine, kbBottomsUp, gets grip-bar)

v2plus.outfit: optional: compression (default: the v2 tee + shorts)
v2plus.sleeve: optional with outfit compression: short (default) | long
v2plus.torso: optional: base (Blender Human Base Meshes torso; implies outfit compression). Default: off = v2 torso
v2plus.limbs: optional: base (needs torso:'base' and the short sleeve). Default: off
v2plus.hands: optional: base (needs limbs:'base'). Default: off = v2 hands on the finger rig
v2plus.head: optional: base (needs torso:'base'). Default: off = the untouched v2 head Toon_Mannequin_Head_v5 (final decision M11, 2026-10-20)
v2plus.regions: optional: baked (whole-body muscle-region atlas, 80 L/R region ids). Default: off
v2plus.skin: optional: default (= omitted = the v2 look) | realistic (no outlines, regions follow v2plus.regions) | tech-white | neon-night | neon-night-b | hologram | hologram-b | plaster (outline skins turn the baked regions on). Unknown names throw. Runtime override: __v2p.setSkin(name); a spec's skin wins.

base: training-human-v2 exactly: same flare-coach.glb, head, neck/collar profile (training-collar.js runs as for training-human-v2), tee, shorts, shoes, solver and camera code. All 13 training-human-v2 source hashes are unchanged.
runtime: drill-anim/lib/render.mjs imports drill-anim/lib/human-v2plus.mjs only when spec.modelProfile is 'training-human-v2plus'; the loader injects page/human-v2plus.js always and page/human-v2plus-regions.js only for regions:'baked' or an outline skin, and reads only the model data files below
data: The seven drill-anim/models/training-human-v2plus-*.json files in sourceSha256 (finger rig + hand poses, compression outfit, base-mesh torso / limbs / hands / head, region table)
build: tools/human-v2plus/ (build_hand.py, build_outfit.py, torso-base/, limbs-base/, hands-base/, head-base/, regions/; inputs: probe.mjs dump of the v2 rest mesh and Blender Human Base Meshes v1.4.1, CC0). Build tools are not runtime and are not hash-pinned.
adds: 15 finger bones per hand (thumb/index/middle/ring/pinky x 3) parented to <side>Hand of Coach_Body; identity rest rotation and the hand's inverse bind, so the rest mesh equals v2.
Hand-region skin weights only: the hand-bone share of hand vertices is split among hand + finger bones; forearm shares and every vertex outside the hands keep their v2 weights.
Named hand poses; grip-bar is least-squares fitted to the accepted v2 baked power grip (drill-anim/assets/grip-left.json) with a 1.5 mm bar clearance term.
Designed muscle-group regions (22 regions, 25 spec group ids) drawn per pixel from the interpolated rest position; replaces the v2 Voronoi mask only while the profile is active.

Opt-in compression outfit (v2plus.outfit: 'compression'): the v2 tee, sleeve trim and shorts shrink-wrapped by smooth fields (no skin exists under them), fold smoothing, hems re-weighted to follow the skin/shorts below them, short-sleeve paint on the arm skin. Body, head, neck, collar zone and shoes untouched; default stays the current clothes.
notChanged: No twist bones, extra spine segments or dual-quaternion skinning (not needed for the rest shape; left for a later step).
The v7 relax morph and the P.bakeGrip vertex bake are bypassed in this profile (grip data is still computed so props are placed exactly as in v2).

defaults.head: v2 Toon_Mannequin_Head_v5 (unchanged)
defaults.body: v2 body, tee, shorts, shoes (unchanged) + 15 finger bones per hand

textHashNormalization: UTF-8 text, CRLF normalized to LF, SHA-256 (same as training-human-v2)
frozenBase: All 13 training-human-v2 sourceSha256 entries (models/training-human-v2.json) are unchanged and still verified.
